articles.summary: Founded in 2001, BuySell Technologies Co., Ltd. has achieved an exceptional 67.8% year-over-year revenue growth rate in the reuse industry. As the company expanded its business, grew its workforce, and actively pursued mergers and acquisitions (M&A), the limitations of its existing perimeter-based security model became increasingly apparent. To address challenges including growing use of networks outside the corporate perimeter, the proliferation of shadow IT, inconsistent security policies across group companies, and the risk of data leakage in the cloud, BuySell Technologies deployed Netskope SASE/SSE and transitioned to a zero trust security model. The rollout began in 2025 and was completed across the entire group in August 2026, establishing a security foundation for continued growth. Looking ahead, the company also plans to expand visibility into shadow AI.
articles.title: BuySell Technologies Moves from Perimeter-Based Security to Zero Trust with Netskope SASE/SSE to Support Rapid Business Growth

He joined EXL in June 2017 and has held several senior leadership roles across operations, service delivery, sales, customer experience and client management. With more than 20 years of experience in the contact centre and business process management industry, Pierre has extensive experience across both the UK and US markets, with particular expertise in the insurance sector. Throughout his career, he has led large-scale customer service, sales, retention and claims operations, with a strong focus on delivering exceptional customer outcomes, operational excellence and sustainable business performance. During his tenure at EXL, Pierre has played an important role in the growth and development of the South Africa business, working across diverse client portfolios and supporting the expansion of EXL’s capabilities in the region. His leadership approach places a strong emphasis on people and culture, client partnerships, consistent operational delivery, and the use of digital, analytics and AI to continuously improve the customer and employee experience. Pierre holds a Certificate in Sales and Marketing from the University of South Africa (UNISA) and a Diploma in Contact Centre Management. Leadership EXL South Africa
